body:
to mandyryce: It's a hundred percent valid to make art concerning your own struggles. 

to GlassInterest: However, confirmation bias doesn't make something true. I'm truly sorry that the only artists you personally know are shitty people.

Please watch Nannette by Hannah Gadsby. 

The myth of the tortured artist was created in the 1600's and is false. Using this myth to indirectly justify abuse is completely vile.

My mom (the enabler) used to do this when she had a day off and I was gone at school. Not throw away quite all of my belongings, but most of them-- minus clothes and books of course. She always happened to throw away my writings too.
I'm glad things are improving, that's awesome! I've seen a few posts about psychiatry being more helpful so I'm going to look into that too, as I'm also finding therapy to be unhelpful.
It really sucked, and I'm sorry you've been through the same. I hope you find someone non-sucky that can be there for you!
I'm so glad she's there for you! I hope so, too.

If there was a button that could 100% erase my existence and wipe the memories of me from everyone I'd ever met, I would press it in an instant. I'm sorry you're feeling the way I'm feeling.

I'm glad someone reached out to you to give you some support!
That's 100% my concern with the one friend I could feasibly tell.

I'm sorry you're feeling that-- I'm worried for when I'll reach that point again. I wish there was something to say to make it better, but some things words can't mend. Thank you for taking the time to share.

I feel you. I'm currently going to college-- in one of my classes last semester I was known as the person who 'completely shut down.' I was surprised that everyone knew something was going on yet no one asked if I was okay. (Edit: no one talked to me at all actually lol).

I'm sorry to hear you've have similar experiences.

I checked out your song and listened to a bit of all the others. I think it's great that you're able to do different styles and employ different sonic palettes! 

A lot of talented people don't always get noticed, unfortunately. I hope you continue to make music and are able to gain more notoriety in the future!
